candidates.hook: Catherine says “Look at you.” while holding a red‑hot poker.
candidates.cliffhanger: Catherine leans in, about to whisper “Because this is what you were always meant to be,” leaving the threat of the scorching iron hanging.
candidates.why: Immediate visual danger and a defiant heroine hook viewers fast.

candidates.hook: Catherine laughs “Love? Look where your precious love brought you.”
candidates.cliffhanger: Juliana is about to retort “If you were truly powerful…” but the clip cuts before her line, leaving the power showdown unresolved.
candidates.why: Emotional stakes of love vs cruelty explode quickly, pulling viewers in.

candidates.hook: Catherine presses the glowing poker into the open pages of Juliana’s mother’s botanical book.
candidates.cliffhanger: The hot iron hovers inches from Juliana’s face, ember reflected in her eye, before the cut—pure terror left hanging.
candidates.why: Visceral danger and a nail‑biting visual make viewers desperate to see what happens next.

moments.desc: Catherine enters the cell brandishing a red‑hot poker and says “Look at you.”
Juliana declares “I call it love.” establishing her defiant love.
Catherine scorches the botanical book with the glowing iron.
The hot poker hovers inches from Juliana’s face, ember reflected in her eye.
